stages.label: agg1
stages.notes: kept -> base harness -> all rollouts produced identical output and no failures observed; no evidence of benefit from changes

agg.why: trivial pool: single final at k=1; delivered without a selector session

experience.cue: when multiple candidates produce identical outputs and no behavioral differences are observed, it is not possible to infer which edit contributed to the adoption
experience.lesson: do not attribute adoption to specific edits when all candidates yield the same result; instead, treat such cases as confounded or inconclusive
experience.evidence: All three candidates (agg1, dom1, inv1) produced identical outputs despite different harnesses being proposed. No concrete execution contrast was observed to support a causal link between any edit and the adopted outcome.
